# @eslint-react (vendored)

Copied from `@eslint-react/eslint-plugin@5.7.1` (MIT) by `packages/lint/scripts/vendor/vendor.ts`. Do not edit these files by hand: change the spec (`scripts/vendor/specs/eslint-react.ts`) or the tool, and run `bun run vendor eslint-react` in packages/lint.
The upstream plugin is spread over packages of one family; the files it reaches are copied to one folder per package (`@eslint-react/eslint-plugin@5.7.1`, `eslint-plugin-react-web-api@5.7.1`, `@eslint-react/var@5.7.1`, `@eslint-react/ast@5.7.1`, `@eslint-react/eslint@5.7.1`, `@eslint-react/core@5.7.1`, `@eslint-react/shared@5.7.1`, `@eslint-react/jsx@5.7.1`, `eslint-plugin-react-rsc@5.7.1`, `eslint-plugin-react-naming-convention@5.7.1`, `eslint-plugin-react-jsx@5.7.1`, `eslint-plugin-react-dom@5.7.1`, `eslint-plugin-react-x@5.7.1`; each keeps its LICENSE), with the imports between them rewritten to relative paths. index.js exposes only the rules enabled in our presets. They run inside oxlint as a JS plugin.

Rules (62): `error-boundaries`, `exhaustive-deps`, `no-access-state-in-setstate`, `no-array-index-key`, `no-children-count`, `no-children-for-each`, `no-children-map`, `no-children-only`, `no-children-to-array`, `no-clone-element`, `no-component-will-mount`, `no-component-will-receive-props`, `no-component-will-update`, `no-context-provider`, `no-create-ref`, `no-direct-mutation-state`, `no-forward-ref`, `no-missing-key`, `no-nested-component-definitions`, `no-nested-lazy-component-declarations`, `no-set-state-in-component-did-mount`, `no-set-state-in-component-did-update`, `no-set-state-in-component-will-update`, `no-unnecessary-use-prefix`, `no-unsafe-component-will-mount`, `no-unsafe-component-will-receive-props`, `no-unsafe-component-will-update`, `no-unused-class-component-members`, `no-unused-state`, `no-use-context`, `purity`, `rules-of-hooks`, `set-state-in-effect`, `set-state-in-render`, `static-components`, `unsupported-syntax`, `use-memo`, `use-state`, `jsx-no-children-prop`, `jsx-no-children-prop-with-children`, `jsx-no-comment-textnodes`, `jsx-no-key-after-spread`, `jsx-no-leaked-dollar`, `jsx-no-leaked-semicolon`, `jsx-no-namespace`, `rsc-function-definition`, `dom-no-dangerously-set-innerhtml`, `dom-no-dangerously-set-innerhtml-with-children`, `dom-no-find-dom-node`, `dom-no-flush-sync`, `dom-no-render-return-value`, `dom-no-script-url`, `dom-no-unsafe-iframe-sandbox`, `dom-no-void-elements-with-children`, `web-api-no-leaked-event-listener`, `web-api-no-leaked-fetch`, `web-api-no-leaked-interval`, `web-api-no-leaked-resize-observer`, `web-api-no-leaked-timeout`, `naming-convention-context-name`, `naming-convention-id-name`, `naming-convention-ref-name`.

## Local patches

- `@eslint-react/ast/lib/index.js`: Import the helper namespace from its subpath: the root of @typescript-eslint/utils imports ESLint, which oxlint doesn't need
- `@eslint-react/ast/lib/index.js`: oxc keeps HTML entities undecoded in JSX text and attribute strings, while typescript-estree (ESLint's parser) decodes them (`&#36;` → `$`): read the decoded value like ESLint did
